description_for_human: Live weather forecasts for any city in the world.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to fetch the current weather and a short-range forecast for any latitude/longitude pair. If the user provides a city name, geocode it first using your own knowledge, then call this API. Returns temperature in Celsius — convert to Fahrenheit yourself when answering the user.

conversation_starters.text: What's the weather in Paris right now?
Will it rain in Seattle this weekend?

functions.name: getForecast
functions.description: Get a 3-day weather forecast for a latitude/longitude pair.
